name: Bursting Bone Vault
description: This bone-filled vault disgorges its contents the moment the vault door slides open.
disable: DC 20 Thievery check (trained) or DC 20 Stealth check (trained) to carefully open the vault door without disturbing the bones

offensiveAbilities.name: Collapse
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature opens the door to the vault

Effect The bones spill from the vault and into the adjacent corridor, dealing 2d10+13 bludgeoning damage to each creature within 10 feet of the door (DC 20 basic Reflex save). The area becomes difficult terrain.
